arms.name: M-TCO-DIRECTIVE-MOVED
arms.note: a `// noqa` / `CHECKSTYLE` / `@formatter` comment moves off the line it governs, so it silences or marks a different line

arms.name: M-COMMENT-DIRECTIVE-NONE
arms.note: no comment reads as a directive, so the reflow and the trailing-comment move both treat `noqa` / `CHECKSTYLE` / `@formatter` markers as prose
